requests.assessment: Initial GET attempted 2026-10-07 with browser-like headers; local sandbox DNS failed before HTTP. Later outside-sandbox GET of /web/ilms/map succeeded and bootstrapped the target viewer session; this is a local environment observation, not a source outage.

Official portal page returned HTTP 200 and general coverage text on 2026-10-07; that page request itself made no spatial-feature query. A later target-specific map selection and point identify on the same date confirmed Manikkal and one parcel.

One point identify at supplied center returned one record with parcel_gid, block_no, survey_no and closed MULTIPOLYGON Z WKT in EPSG:32643. Sanitized geometry and safe IDs are in city-10023-parcel-response.json; owner/personal fields were discarded.

Exact single-parcel lookup by `attributes.parcel_gid` returned one geometry record with the same safe IDs and MULTIPOLYGON Z WKT. The first guess `attributes.parcel_id` returned an empty array; corrected to the actual `parcel_gid` field exposed in point identify. Sanitized reply: city-10023-parcel-by-id-response.json.
